limitations: Identifier presence is diagnostic, not proof of an entailment or a correct subject binding.
A provenance follow requires a prior get_note, matching source identity/hash, and verified excerpt containing its quote.
An object follow can return zero facts; this measures actual traversal attempts, not useful multi-hop inference.
Manual semantic reviews are bound to the exact answer hash; raw strict scores are unchanged.
